name: Cygnus 13
detailed_description:
Story                                                                                                                                                       

You startle awake to find yourself on on the interplanetary cruiser Cygnus-13, with no memories of your past.​ The ship's crew has rescued you from floating, alone and unconscious, in the depths of space. Trapped on a foreign ship with unfamiliar crewmates, you realize these people are now your only lifeline to survive what feels like a strange, new galaxy.

You must gain the trust of this crew that have taken you in with (only somewhat hesitantly) open arms in order to find out who you are and what has brought you here. Of course, tempers finally flare when you realize that something - or someone - wants you all dead. But if you're lucky, you may just find a special ending with the alien of your dreams.​

Key Features                                                                                                                                          

Choices Matter: You must make active choices throughout the game, sometimes gaining favor with one character and earning disdain from another. This will have a direct effect on which ending you get and who you date. You won’t be able to see every scene in just one playthrough, so remember to save early and save often!

Date Aliens: Meet our diverse cast of characters and pick one of the four available aliens to get close to! Niall is hardworking and kind, though a bit awkward socially. Keekyne has a bold, outgoing personality that - almost - everyone can get along with. RGB are three separate beings connected by a hivemind. And M1NG, the medical robot, can help heal your wounds… but what else are they capable of?

Mini Games: Each dating option has their own mini-game that corresponds to their job on board the Cygnus-13. Play through them to help them out with their work and learn a bit more about them in the process.

short_description: Cygnus-13 is a multi-branched visual novel in which you must rediscover who you are after being found floating in space and losing your memories. In the process of remembering your past, you will begin to forge a new future with the special alien of your choice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Version: Windows 7 or higher.
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.10+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0

content_descriptors.notes: The mature content in the Cygnus-13 demo will mostly revolve around violence, specifically flashbacks to being held captive, mentions of experimentations on bodies, and one intense and distressing scene of impending death. There are also references to kissing and humorous sex acts as the narrator finds herself caught up in her attraction to many of the other characters.
